preconditions.description: The length of the binary string b is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'0', '1'} for c in b)
preconditions.description: The binary string b contains only the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(b[i:i+3] == '010' for i in range(len(b) - 2))
postconditions.description: The return value is the number of non-overlapping occurrences of the substring '010' in the binary string b.
